title: Explore on Your Own — Vim Vim Connect Launchpad
markdown:
# Explore at your own pace

Learn what makes Vim different, then jump into the tools to start building.

**No Console access?**
Use the Start Building request form - we'll follow up shortly.
[Request access](https://launchpad.getvim.com/start-building#request-access)

[**Open Vim Console** \\
\\
Create your app manifest, configure permissions, and get your client ID and secret keys.\\
\\
Start Building](https://console.getvim.com/organization-admin)

**Sandbox?**
Opens from Console once you're in - same request form.
[Request access](https://launchpad.getvim.com/start-building#request-access)

[**Launch Sandbox EHR** \\
\\
Test your app with simulated patient data in a realistic EHR environment. No real PHI.\\
\\
Test Environment](https://console.getvim.com/organization-admin/sandbox-ehr)

Why Vim

What makes Vim the platform of choice for innovators building health-tech and the care teams using it.

[**Why Innovators Choose Vim** \\
\\
One platform to build, embed, and scale health-tech apps inside the EHR — from dev console to marketplace.\\
\\
Learn](https://launchpad.getvim.com/why-innovators?hsLang=en) [**Why Care Teams Choose Vim** \\
\\
Zero disruption, curated apps, and self-service onboarding — tools that fit right into the clinical workflow.\\
\\
Learn](https://launchpad.getvim.com/why-care-teams?hsLang=en)

SDK & code

Documentation, references, and working examples to get your integration running.

[**SDK Documentation** \\
\\
Full VimOS.js reference — installation, authentication, EHR connectivity, and Hub features.\\
\\
Docs](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up) [**Sample Apps on GitHub** \\
\\
Working VimOS.js examples and starter templates. Clone, run, and modify to jumpstart your build.\\
\\
Code](https://github.com/getvim/vim-canvas-demo-app)

Commercial

Pricing

Commercial terms depend on your product, expected usage, and how you go to market with Vim. We do not publish a standard price list online.

Getting a quote requires a discussion with our team so we can align on scope, timelines, and what is included in your agreement.

[Schedule a call](https://meetings.hubspot.com/alon-danby)
